profile.summary: Vision To Learn is a nonprofit that provides eye exams and eyeglasses at no cost to students in low-income communities. It brings vision care to students at their schools. It is based in Los Angeles and also serves Bay Area schools, including Oakland.

review.notes: Vision To Learn, Inc. is a Los Angeles 501(c)(3) (EIN 45-3457853 confirmed on its About page and ProPublica) that provides free eye exams and glasses via school-based mobile clinics, and its own news page names Oakland Unified students, matching the no-cost Health Services agreement.
